'''The Hammers''' was one of the three [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belts]] that ringed the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Christoph]] in the [[Christoph system/Legends|Christoph system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The asteroid belts added to the beauty of the planet [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]], but [[Meteor/Legends|meteorites]] originating from them regularly bombarded the planet, while the chaotic nature of the belts made [[Mining/Legends|mining]] them an expensive and risky prospect. Of the three belts, The Hammers was situated between two planets in the system, Christophsis and [[Erodsis]].

==History==
===A golden age beckoned===
For [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]], the [[Christoph system/Legends|Christoph system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] was famous for the beauty of its [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belts]] and the difficulty of making a profit from them. The belts, dubbed the [[The Barren]], Hammers, and [[The Halo|Halo]], were whirling chaos, and stray [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] regularly bombarded the system's lone habitable world, [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]].<ref name="EA" /> Despite the risks and expense involved,<ref name="FF" /> around [[600 BBY/Legends|600 BBY]],<ref name="EA" /><ref name="FF" /> a wealthy<ref name="FF" /> family of [[Tepasi/Legends|Tepasi]] nobles<ref name="EA" /><ref name="FF" /> from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]], seeking an investment opportunity,<ref name="FF" /> made the investments necessary to turn the system into a worthwhile [[Mining/Legends|mining]] concern,<ref name="EA" /> kickstarting a [[Standard century/Legends|century]]-long transformation.<ref name="FF" />

[[File:Christophsis_TEA.jpg|thumb|left|260px|The exploitation of the asteroid belts ushered in the golden age of Christophsis]]
Over a century, at massive expense, the [[Christophsian/Legends|Christophsians]] hired [[Givin/Legends|Givin]] mathematicians to plot the courses of countless asteroids, eliminating the ones that endangered their new home.<ref name="EA" /> Brave technicians and daring [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] then set about vaporizing the dangerous asteroids and otherwise stabilizing the Barren, Hammers, and Halo belts. Once the asteroid belts were stable,<ref name="FF" /> the Christophsians brought in the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]]<ref name="EA" /><ref name="FF" /> of the [[Roche asteroid field|Roche asteroid field]] to help equip their [[Miner/Legends|miners]] to survey and efficiently exploit the Christoph system's resources.<ref name="FF" /> With the help of Verpine technologists, they refined [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and mining technologies that allowed prospectors to work in the tumbling belts.<ref name="EA" /> When deposits of numerous rare [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] [[Ore/Legends|ores]],<ref name="FF" /> such as [[chanlon]], [[hfredium]], [[Quadrillium/Legends|quadrillium]], and [[Nergon-14/Legends|nergon-14]], proved abundant, the Christophsians' big bet had paid off many times over, and they were not inclined to share.<ref name="EA" /> They sought out the best [[Lawyer/Legends|lawyers]] the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] had to offer<ref name="FF" /> – the [[Vippit]]<ref name="EA" /><ref name="FF" /> – and used their services to ensure that only the rulers of Christophsis would ever profit from mining the three asteroid belts and the planet itself.<ref name="FF" /> To disenfranchise their Givin and Verpine partners, the Christophsians renamed the system in their own honor and retreated to gleaming [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] [[City/Legends|cities]] on Christophsis to bask in the luster of their accomplishments.<ref name="EA" />

===Later history===
[[File:Christophsis_landscape.png|thumb|right|270px|Christophsian oligarchs controlled mineral mining in the asteroid belts]]
By the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Christophsian oligarchs had won grudging admiration from the rest of the galaxy for their careful manipulation of mineral markets and their mining expertise, and widespread suspicion for their secrecy and self-absorption. Even high-ranking fellow members of the [[Mining Guild/Legends|Mining Guild]] were rarely invited to Christophsis itself, received instead by dour, robed Christophsians in the utilitarian space habitats that dotted the outermost reaches of the Halo belt. From there, they could watch reckless mine-rocket jockeys from all parts of the galaxy twist through the asteroids in search of new claims to make on behalf of their oligarch backers. Mentioning a successful tenure as a pilot in the Christophsis belts was a sure way to end inquiries about one's ability to fly a starship.<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Christoph system/Legends|Christoph system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="EA" />
